001package com.streamconverter.command.impl.json;
002
003import com.fasterxml.jackson.core.JsonFactory;
004import com.fasterxml.jackson.core.JsonGenerator;
005import com.fasterxml.jackson.core.JsonParser;
006import com.fasterxml.jackson.core.JsonToken;
007import com.streamconverter.UncheckedStreamException;
008import com.streamconverter.command.IStreamCommand;
009import com.streamconverter.command.rule.IRule;
010import com.streamconverter.path.TreePath;
011import java.io.IOException;
012import java.io.InputStream;
013import java.io.OutputStream;
014import java.util.ArrayList;
015import java.util.List;
016
017/**
018 * JSON Walker for applying transformations to JSON data.
019 *
020 * <p>This command navigates through JSON structures and applies transformations using rules while
021 * preserving the overall JSON structure.
022 *
023 * <p>Responsibilities: - Navigate to specified JSON paths - Apply transformation rules to matching
024 * elements - Preserve JSON structure during transformation - Stream processing for memory
025 * efficiency
026 */
027public class JsonWalker implements IStreamCommand {
028
029  private final TreePath treePath;
030  private final IRule rule;
031  private final JsonFactory jsonFactory;
032
033  /**
034   * Constructor for JSON navigation with TreePath selector and transformation rule.
035   *
036   * @param treePath the TreePath to select data
037   * @param rule the transformation rule to apply to selected elements
038   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if treePath or rule is null
039   */
040  private JsonWalker(TreePath treePath, IRule rule) {
041    this.treePath = treePath;
042    this.rule = rule;
043    this.jsonFactory = new JsonFactory();
044  }
045
046  /**
047   * Factory method for creating a JSON navigation command with TreePath and rule.
048   *
049   * @param treePath the TreePath to select data
050   * @param rule the transformation rule to apply to selected elements
051   * @return a JsonWalker that transforms the specified path with the given rule
052   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if treePath or rule is null
053   */
054  public static JsonWalker create(TreePath treePath, IRule rule) {
055    if (treePath == null) {
056      throw new IllegalArgumentException("TreePath cannot be null");
057    }
058    if (rule == null) {
059      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Rule cannot be null");
060    }
061    return new JsonWalker(treePath, rule);
062  }
063
064  @Override
065  public void execute(InputStream inputStream, OutputStream outputStream) throws IOException {
066    processJsonWithStreaming(inputStream, outputStream);
067  }
068
069  /** Stream JSON processing with structure preservation */
070  private void processJsonWithStreaming(InputStream inputStream, OutputStream outputStream)
071      throws IOException {
072    try (JsonParser parser = jsonFactory.createParser(inputStream);
073        JsonGenerator generator = jsonFactory.createGenerator(outputStream)) {
074
075      // Process with JSONPath filtering - transform matching elements
076      processJsonStreamWithPath(parser, generator);
077
078      generator.flush();
079    }
080  }
081
082  /** Process JSON with specific JSONPath targeting */
083  private void processJsonStreamWithPath(JsonParser parser, JsonGenerator generator)
084      throws IOException {
085    int depth = 0;
086    List<String> currentPath = new ArrayList<>();
087    JsonToken token;
088    while ((token = parser.nextToken()) != null) {
089      switch (token) {
090        case FIELD_NAME -> depth = handleFieldName(parser, generator, depth, currentPath);
091        case VALUE_STRING -> handleValueString(parser, generator, currentPath);
092        case START_OBJECT -> {
093          depth++;
094          generator.writeStartObject();
095        }
096        case END_OBJECT -> depth = handleEndObject(generator, depth, currentPath);
097        case START_ARRAY -> generator.writeStartArray();
098        case END_ARRAY -> generator.writeEndArray();
099        default -> generator.copyCurrentEvent(parser);
100      }
101    }
102  }
103
104  private int handleFieldName(
105      JsonParser parser, JsonGenerator generator, int depth, List<String> currentPath)
106      throws IOException {
107    String fieldName = parser.currentName();
108    while (currentPath.size() < depth) {
109      currentPath.add(null);
110    }
111    while (currentPath.size() > depth) {
112      currentPath.remove(currentPath.size() - 1);
113    }
114    if (depth > 0) {
115      currentPath.set(depth - 1, fieldName);
116    }
117    generator.writeFieldName(fieldName);
118    return depth;
119  }
120
121  private void handleValueString(
122      JsonParser parser, JsonGenerator generator, List<String> currentPath) throws IOException {
123    String originalValue = parser.getText();
124    if (isMatchingPath(currentPath)) {
125      generator.writeString(applyRule(originalValue, currentPath));
126    } else {
127      generator.writeString(originalValue);
128    }
129  }
130
131  @SuppressWarnings({"PMD.AvoidCatchingGenericException", "PMD.PreserveStackTrace"})
132  // IRule.apply() declares no checked exceptions. Rule-layer I/O failures arrive wrapped in the
133  // UncheckedStreamException carrier and are unwrapped at this command boundary (#741); the cause
134  // already records the rule-site stack trace, so discarding the carrier loses no diagnostics.
135  // Any other RuntimeException is wrapped as IOException with path context.
136  private String applyRule(String value, List<String> currentPath) throws IOException {
137    try {
138      return rule.apply(value);
139    } catch (UncheckedStreamException carrier) {
140      throw carrier.getCause();
141    } catch (RuntimeException ruleEx) {
142      throw new IOException("Rule application failed at path " + currentPath, ruleEx);
143    }
144  }
145
146  private int handleEndObject(JsonGenerator generator, int depth, List<String> currentPath)
147      throws IOException {
148    int newDepth = depth - 1;
149    while (currentPath.size() > newDepth) {
150      currentPath.remove(currentPath.size() - 1);
151    }
152    generator.writeEndObject();
153    return newDepth;
154  }
155
156  private boolean isMatchingPath(List<String> currentPath) {
157    return treePath.matches(currentPath);
158  }
159}
